sourceText: In the proofbound repo, packages/main/src/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.ts fails on a clean main tree: the assertion 'registered lattice-review-channel example field agentType must be schema-valid' fails. The user reviewed the naive fix (add the agent to the enum) and steered toward bidirectional-consistency criteria, fixing the guard rather than the catalog, and asked to evaluate wiring the smoke into validate.commands and to route the change through a Lattice story.
normalizedOutcome: node packages/main/dist/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.js exits 0 on clean main, and lattice validate runs that smoke, which asserts bidirectional consistency between the dispatch agentType enum and the retired-agent registry (dispatchable accepted; retired rejected by both schema and runtime).
acceptanceClaim: Running node packages/main/dist/tasks/command-catalog-smoke.js exits 0; the smoke fails if a retired agent (lattice-review-channel) is accepted by the dispatch agentType schema, or a dispatchable agent is rejected.
